identities.source_correspondence: Source revisions identify retained release builds; report hashes independently bind executable and workload bytes. Measurement reports alone do not establish compilation correspondence.

protocol.name: instrumented_derived_workload_matrix_v2
protocol.median_rule: Arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted samples; displayed intervals span the separate repeated-leg medians, not pooled samples.
protocol.phase_scope: Initial grounding excludes streamed checking. Original validation includes region preparation/checks and final checks, overlaps candidate generation, and may sum worker durations; it is not additive with solving wall.
protocol.rss_scope: Only memory-phase peak_rss_bytes are memory observations. Their outer wall includes the helper and is excluded from timed wall comparisons.

verification.family_comparison: Incremental schema-2 native catalogs decoded into typed full atoms, shown atoms/terms and priority-tagged costs; sorted with multiplicity. Same workload compared across both revisions, profiles, repetitions and worker counts.
verification.family_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: object keys sorted, ordered typed value nodes retained, each model represented by sorted canonical full/shown atom strings, sorted shown-term strings and canonical cost; canonical model strings sorted with multiplicity. Signed 64-bit cost integers beyond JSON safe range use a $integer decimal-string tag.
verification.reference_scope: Maintained qualification compares complete selected displays and costs; hidden reference interpretations are unavailable.
verification.failure_scope: All four baseline failures are Queens02 N5 lazy qualification work-limit refusals. Their incomplete output is not a family or a timing/RSS baseline; seven subsequent positions per cell remain not_attempted.

sample_metric_units: Keys ending elapsed_ns and driver_elapsed_ns are nanoseconds; retained/source/search work fields are their named integer counters. Null means unavailable, never zero.
